subject_notes: Naval nuclear reactor manufacturing (sole-source to USN), nuclear fuel, medical isotopes
scope_note: BWXT's primary U.S. Government revenue (Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program, DOE/NNSA cleanup contracts) flows through DOE/NNSA budget channels, NOT DoD RDT&E/Procurement Program Elements. The Pentagon J-Book corpus (Air Force / Space Force / DARPA / MDA / SOCOM / OSD) does not cover Navy nuclear or DOE/NNSA lines. Per J-Book Calibration Heuristic #7, NOT_FOUND for these claims is expected and treated as UNVERIFIABLE (coverage gap), not as a red flag. The doe_budget M-source covers DOE Office of Science (ASCR/BES/BER/FES/HEP/NP) but per its docstring does NOT yet ingest NNSA, ARPA-E, or EERE volumes, so DOE/NNSA Naval Propulsion is also outside its scope.

claims.claim_text: BWXT's Government Operations segment engineers, designs, and manufactures precision naval nuclear components, reactors, and nuclear fuel for the U.S. DOE/NNSA's Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program; the demand for nuclear components by the U.S. Government determines a substantial portion of this segment's backlog.
claims.subject: BWXT Government Operations segment
claims.source_quote: Through this segment, we engineer, design and manufacture precision naval nuclear components, reactors and nuclear fuel for the U.S. Department of Energy ('DOE')/National Nuclear Security Administration's ('NNSA') Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program

claims.claim_text: In FY2025, sales to the U.S. Government accounted for approximately 91% of BWXT's Government Operations segment revenues (vs. 95% in 2024 and 93% in 2023).
claims.subject: Government Operations segment revenue
claims.source_quote: Government accounted for approximately 91 %, 95 % and 93 % of our Government Operations segment revenues, respectively.

claims.claim_text: U.S. Government contracts (directly or via sub-tier) comprised approximately 68% of BWXT's total consolidated revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025.
claims.subject: BWXT consolidated revenue
claims.source_quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, whether directly or as a sub-tier contractor to a government contractor, U.S. Government contracts comprised approximately 68% of our total consolidated revenues.

claims.claim_text: BWXT cites the March 2024 U.S. Navy 30-year shipbuilding plan — all three procurement profiles indicate growth in total ships and a sustained or increased procurement profile for nuclear-powered submarines and aircraft carriers — as the forward-demand basis for additional capex and headcount in Government Operations.
claims.subject: Forward naval-reactor demand
claims.object_value: U.S. Navy 30-year shipbuilding plan (sustained/growing nuclear submarine + carrier procurement)
claims.source_quote: In March 2024, the U.S. Navy issued its 30-year shipbuilding plan containing three alternative procurement profiles based upon varied funding assumptions. All three indicate growth in the total number of ships and a sustained, or increased, procurement profile for nuclear-powered submarines and aircraft carriers. We plan to make additional capital expenditures and investments in personnel to meet the current demand requirements

claims.claim_text: BWXT's Government Operations segment serves advanced-reactor customers including NASA, the U.S. Department of War (DoW, i.e., Department of Defense), and DOE; BWXT offers complete advanced nuclear fuel and reactor design, engineering, licensing, and manufacturing services for these programs (power and propulsion in space and terrestrial domains).
claims.subject: BWXT advanced reactor / space nuclear business line
claims.source_quote: The Government Operations segment is also a leader in the development of advanced nuclear reactors for a variety of power and propulsion applications in the space and terrestrial domains. U.S. Government customers for these applications include NASA, the U.S. Department of War ('DoW'), also known as the Department of Defense, and the DOE.

claims.claim_text: BWXT's ending backlog at December 31, 2025 was $7,260.7 million, including $2,151.3 million of unfunded backlog related to U.S. Government contracts, with approximately 40% of revenue expected to recognize by end of 2026. Unexercised options excluded from backlog were ~$2,800 million (expecting $1.4B awarded 2026, $0.9B in 2030, $0.5B in 2035), subject to Congressional appropriations.
claims.subject: BWXT forward backlog and option pipeline
claims.source_quote: At December 31, 2025, our ending backlog was $7,260.7 million, which included $2,151.3 million of unfunded backlog related to U.S. Government contracts ... The value of unexercised options excluded from backlog as of December 31, 2025 was approximately $2,800 million. We expect $1,400 million to be awarded in 2026, $900 million to be awarded in 2030 and $500 million to be awarded in 2035, subject to Congressional appropriations.

claims.claim_text: On January 3, 2025, BWXT completed the acquisition of Aerojet Ordnance Tennessee (A.O.T.) from L3Harris Technologies; A.O.T. is described as a leading provider of advanced special materials reported in Government Operations. On May 20, 2025, BWXT completed the acquisition of Kinectrics Holdings (lifecycle services for global nuclear power, T&D, and radiopharmaceutical isotopes), reported in Commercial Operations.
claims.subject: BWXT rollup / acquisition strategy 2025
claims.object_value: A.O.T. (from L3Harris, Jan 2025) and Kinectrics Holdings (May 2025)
claims.source_quote: On January 3, 2025, we completed the acquisition of Aerojet Ordnance Tennessee, Inc. ('A.O.T'), a subsidiary of L3Harris Technologies, Inc. ... On May 20, 2025, we completed the acquisition Kinectrics Holdings, Inc., the parent company of Kinectrics, Inc.

claims.claim_text: BWXT's Commercial Operations segment's major customers are large utilities; in FY2025, large utility customers accounted for approximately 63% of Commercial Operations revenues (vs. 71% in 2024 and 77% in 2023), reflecting the declining utility-revenue share following the Kinectrics acquisition.
claims.subject: Commercial Operations revenue mix
claims.source_quote: In the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, sales to large utility customers accounted for approximately 63 %, 71 % and 77 % of our Commercial Operations segment revenues, respectively.

claims.claim_text: BWXT's medical isotope business will be the platform for its planned Molybdenum-99 (Mo-99) product line and additional radioisotope-based imaging, diagnostic, and therapeutic products.
claims.subject: BWXT Commercial Operations / medical isotope line
claims.source_quote: The medical isotope business will be the platform from which we plan to launch our Molybdenum-99 product line and a number of future radioisotope-based imaging, diagnostic and therapeutic products.

claims.claim_text: BWXT identifies itself as the sole-source supplier of certain proprietary valves, manifolds, and fittings to global naval and commercial shipping customers, and asserts it is positioned as a long-tenured supplier of nuclear components to U.S. DOE programs since the 1950s.
claims.subject: BWXT sole-source position
claims.source_quote: we supply proprietary and sole-source valves, manifolds and fittings to global naval and commercial shipping customers ... We have supplied nuclear components for DOE programs since the 1950s
